issue.title: Record the fail-closed sase tool run -H rule as a decisions strand and mark record-before-admit superseded in part
issue.description:
Proposed by phase bead sase-17p.6 (epic sase-17p, E2 durable ToolRun hand-off) as a
PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note, per the epic plan's "Memory and governance" section, which
deliberately did not write it; filed by the sase-17p land agent on 2026-09-24.

E2 settled a change of course that the decisions web does not record yet. Explicit
`sase tool run -H` is fail-closed: if the ToolRun reservation cannot be committed,
nothing starts and the command exits 1 naming the foreground form, because the printed
run id is the only handle a caller gets and must be durable. Foreground
`sase tool run` stays fail-open, and a monitor start's reservation is fail-open (the
monitor id is already the durable handle, so it falls back to E1.5 wrapping with one
reason line). This narrows one clause of `decisions:record-before-admit` ("recording
stays fail-open") for explicit hand-offs only. docs/tool.md documents the rule today
(plan decision 3 of plan:202609/tool_e2_durable_handoff.md).

Wanted, through /sase_memory_write: a new decisions strand for the fail-closed explicit
hand-off rule (claim, why over fail-open, cost, reopen condition), plus a
superseded-in-part mark and `[[...]]` back-link on `decisions:record-before-admit`,
following the web's immutable-record convention.

task_type_fields.proposed_change: Add a new decisions strand for E2's fail-closed explicit hand-off (sase tool run -H refuses and starts nothing when its ToolRun reservation cannot be recorded; foreground and monitor-start recording stay fail-open), and mark record-before-admit superseded-in-part with a back-link to it.

payload.entry: Verified sase memory read renders both records with Linked References and the dual-superseder status line; sase memory init --check clean; rule confirmed in docs/tool.md

payload.close_reason: Recorded as decisions/explicit-handoff-fails-closed.md with claim, durable-handle rationale, caller cost, evidence-based reopen, and [[decisions/record-before-admit]] + [[decisions/guarded-recipes]] links; record-before-admit marked superseded-in-part with both superseders and back-link paragraph, claim body untouched
